purpose: Independently collected student queries for the Physics and Chemistry retrieval benchmark (next promotion milestone — see NEXT_MILESTONE.md). Students write queries without seeing the stored questions. Label relevant IDs afterward. Only entries with label.status relevant or no-relevant-result are scored. pending and unresolved are never scored. Freeze this set before tuning hybrid weights.

target.note: Proposed engineering target, not a statistical guarantee of production readiness.

collection: Open eval/student-query-form.html in a browser to copy JSON records.
Ask each student to write a question they would search for, without showing them the stored questions.
Paste the query exactly as written, keeping spelling, capitalisation, punctuation, numbers, units, and equations. Do not correct or rephrase it.
Keep unrelated questions if students write them. Do not add queries to balance the set.
Do not record student names. studentRef is an optional anonymous code such as S01.
Set sawBank to false for the independent set. Records with sawBank true are validated but excluded from scoring.
labelling: After collection is complete, a reviewer who did not write the queries maps each query to question IDs.
relevant: the stored question is what the student was looking for. List every relevant id.
no-relevant-result: the bank does not contain a suitable question. relevantIds must be empty.
unresolved: the reviewer cannot confidently determine relevance. Use suggestedIds only. Not scored.
pending: not yet labelled. Not scored.
A glass prism question is not automatically relevant to a glass sphere query.
Run npm run validate:student-queries before scoring.

entryFormat.subject: Physics | Chemistry | Mathematics | Other
entryFormat.sawBank: must be false for a scored independent entry

label.type: optional category override used in per-type metrics
